Remark
[Rescaled metrics have bounded scalar curvature on large balls] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0071 ↗ thm:chow-iii-point-picking-infinite-ascr 1. ch18:18.11\group Spatial Point Picking

For $g_i=R(x_i)g$, one has $R_{g_i}(x_i)=1$ and \[ \sup _{B_{g_i}(x_i,\widetilde r_i)}R_{g_i}\le 1+\varepsilon _i, \qquad \widetilde r_i=R(x_i)^{1/2}r_i\to \infty , \] while $d_{g_i}(x_i,O)\to \infty $.
